#!/bin/bash
# The tables by doc id over the grown 10M index, before and after
# (bench-report.md of feat/posting-edge-index, "Las tablas por docID sobre el
# 10M", pre-registered on 2026-11-28): the search of an insert alone, the
# inserts with 8 callers and with 1, and the heap, each pass on an APFS clone
# of its own of the index, removed after it. before.test is m2 (8ed921ed59)
# and after.test m2 with the tables (0e69426e81), with the same harness; both
# built before, nothing here builds. Timed: marker, idle wait, caffeinate.
set -u
S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad
X=$S/diag
D=$HOME/Documents/datasets/wikidpr-10m-e5-inplace.bin
P=adapters/repos/db/vector/postingedge

printf 'the tables by doc id over the 10M index, before and after (diag/tables10m.sh), timed, since %s for about an hour; taken down by the experiments session\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" > $S/timed-session.lock

hid_idle() { ioreg -c IOHIDSystem | awk '/HIDIdleTime/ {print int($NF/1000000000); exit}'; }
date "+== %H:%M:%S waiting for 900 s of idle (now $(hid_idle) s)"
while [ "$(hid_idle)" -lt 900 ]; do sleep 30; done
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S idle for $(hid_idle) s"

# run <name> <before|after> <test> [NAME=value ...]
run() {
  local name=$1 bin=$2 test=$3
  shift 3
  local C=$X/tb10m/$name
  local tree=$X/m2
  [ $bin = after ] && tree=$X/tables
  local free=$(df -k $X | tail -n 1 | awk '{print int($4/1048576)}')
  if [ "$free" -lt 10 ]; then
    date "+== %H:%M:%S $name NOT RUN: $free GiB free, under 10"
    return
  fi
  mkdir -p $C
  cp -c -R $S/grow10m/index $C/index || exit 3
  # The store read once; the vectors stay as cold as a new clone is.
  find $C/index/lsm -type f -exec cat {} + > /dev/null
  # The heap is read from a profile of every allocation.
  local flags=""
  [ $test = TestNightHeap ] && flags="-test.memprofilerate=1"
  date "+== %H:%M:%S $name: $bin $test $*"
  (cd $tree/$P && exec env PE_DATASET=$D PE_DIR=$C/index PE_OUT=$C/result.json "$@" \
    $X/$bin.test -test.run "^$test\$" -test.v -test.timeout 0 $flags > $C/run.log 2>&1) &
  local pid=$!
  python3 -I -B $X/monitor.py $pid $C/monitor.jsonl 2 > $C/monitor.err 2>&1 &
  wait $pid
  echo "$name exit $?"
  wait
  find /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad/diag/tb10m -type d -name index -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
}

# 1. The search of an insert alone, 1 thread, 5 000 plans: three rounds in turn.
for r in 1 2 3; do
  run search-t1-before-r$r before TestDiagSearch PE_THREADS=1 PE_N=5000
  run search-t1-after-r$r after TestDiagSearch PE_THREADS=1 PE_N=5000
done
# 2. 20 000 inserts with 8 callers: three rounds in turn.
for r in 1 2 3; do
  run inserts-c8-before-r$r before TestDiagInserts PE_CALLERS=8
  run inserts-c8-after-r$r after TestDiagInserts PE_CALLERS=8
done
# 3. 20 000 inserts with 1 caller: two rounds in turn.
for r in 1 2; do
  run inserts-c1-before-r$r before TestDiagInserts PE_CALLERS=1
  run inserts-c1-after-r$r after TestDiagInserts PE_CALLERS=1
done
# 4. The heap of each binary over the index, opened with its codes in memory.
for bin in before after; do
  run heap-$bin $bin TestNightHeap PE_CACHE=routing PE_HEAP=$X/tb10m/heap-$bin/heap.heap PE_OUT=$X/tb10m/heap-$bin/heap.json
done
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S passes done" | tee $X/tb10m/end.txt
rm -f /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad/timed-session.lock
